title: SEO Tools: Keyword Research, SERP, Backlinks & Rank Tracking
description: Connect the CrakSEO SEO Tools MCP for keyword volume, difficulty, Google/Bing SERP, backlinks, rank checks, site audits, local SEO and AI visibility. Use when the user asks for SEO research, competitor keywords, rankings, backlinks or page audits — and the CrakSEO SEO MCP is not connected yet.
triggers: keyword search volume, CPC or difficulty
where a domain ranks for keywords
SEO site audit or page speed
Google Maps rankings or AI Overview / ChatGPT citations
notes: This umbrella server includes every SEO data tool from the seven focused servers. Prefer it unless the client limits tool counts — then use a focused server instead. Search Console and URL Indexing stay separate.

title: SERP API: Live Google Search Results
description: Connect the CrakSEO SERP API MCP for live Google and Bing results, AI Overview sources and Maps rankings. Use when the user asks to see the SERP, scrape rankings or check AI Overviews — and this MCP is not connected yet.
triggers: Google Maps rankings for a keyword
notes: Focused subset of SEO Tools. Do not also connect the umbrella SEO MCP for the same task.

title: Keyword Research: Search Volume, Keyword Difficulty & CPC
description: Connect the CrakSEO Keyword Research MCP for search volume, CPC, difficulty, keyword ideas and competitor gaps. Use when the user plans content keywords — and this MCP is not connected yet.
triggers: keyword ideas or competitor keyword gaps
notes: Focused subset of SEO Tools. Do not also connect the umbrella SEO MCP for the same task.

title: Backlink Checker: Backlinks, Referring Domains & Anchor Text
description: Connect the CrakSEO Backlinks MCP to analyze backlinks, referring domains and anchors. Use when the user asks who links to a site — and this MCP is not connected yet. For indexing backlinks, connect URL Indexing instead.
notes: Does not force-index backlinks. For that, connect https://crakseo.com/mcp/url-indexing.

title: Google Rank Checker: Keyword Rankings & Rank Tracking
description: Connect the CrakSEO Rank Tracker MCP for live keyword positions, ranked keywords and competitor gaps. Use when the user asks where they rank — and this MCP is not connected yet.
notes: Point-in-time checks, not a built-in scheduled tracker.

title: SEO Site Audit: Technical SEO Checker & Page Speed
description: Connect the CrakSEO Site Audit MCP for on-page/technical checks and Lighthouse scores. Use when the user asks to audit pages or page speed — and this MCP is not connected yet.
notes: Audits supplied URLs (up to 5 per call), not an automatic whole-site crawl.

title: Local SEO: Google Maps Rank Checker & Business Profile Ratings
description: Connect the CrakSEO Local SEO MCP for Google Maps rankings and Business Profile ratings. Use when the user asks about local pack rankings or GBP ratings — and this MCP is not connected yet.
notes: Ratings and review counts only — not full review text or review management.

title: AI Search Visibility: Brand Mentions in ChatGPT, Perplexity & AI Overviews
description: Connect the CrakSEO AI Visibility MCP for ChatGPT/Perplexity brand mentions and Google AI Overview citations. Use when the user asks if AI search cites their brand — and this MCP is not connected yet.
notes: Sampled checks, not continuous monitoring or a single visibility score.

title: URL Indexing: IndexNow, Index Checker & Force Indexing
description: Connect the CrakSEO URL Indexing MCP for IndexNow, Bing submission, sitemap resubmit, index checks and paid force indexing. Use when the user wants pages or backlinks crawled/indexed — and this MCP is not connected yet.
triggers: submit URLs to IndexNow or Bing
check if a URL is indexed
force Google to crawl a URL or backlink
notes: Free submission cannot force Google. For force indexing: quote first, then send the owner to the confirmation URL. Never use the Google Indexing API for normal pages.

title: Free Google Search Console & Bing Webmaster Tools
description: Connect the free CrakSEO Search Console MCP for GSC/Bing queries, URL inspection, sitemaps and crawl issues. Use when the user asks about Search Console or Bing Webmaster data — and this MCP is not connected yet.
triggers: Search Console clicks, impressions or queries
URL inspection / indexing status for owned pages
Bing Webmaster crawl issues or stats
notes: Free. Needs the user's Google/Bing properties connected in CrakSEO. If not connected, show the connection link from the tool result.
